# H2: SPACE only works at cross centers. Goal involves connecting blocks to cross centers.
# Player at (19, 27), need to get to orange center (18, 27) first.

r = action(['UP'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        w_pos = n['boundary'][0]
        print(f"Player at: ({w_pos[0]}, {w_pos[1]})")

        w_pos = n['boundary'][0]

    for n in red_multi:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"Red multi: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
